annotations.title: Meta ads: reach, messages, offers and landing pages

description: Everything on the app's Meta Ads tab for your brand vs rivals, untrimmed: reach (accounts that saw the ads, UK/EU only) and reach by market, all top ads by reach and by days running plus ended long-runners (full copy, links), hook angles with what each brand tests vs funds, hooks by country with every angle count, the punch of each analysed ad read from the creative itself (image, carousel cards or the whole video with its sound: the idea that stops the scroll, on-screen text, first words spoken, format, references) with context only where a source is linked (calendar event named in the ad, a page about the reference) and what each brand tests vs funds per punch type, offers and codes, CTA mix, formats, languages, creators, new promoters, campaign tags, sites and every promoted page (name, price, stock, category, live ads, reach, broken links). Up to 6 brands per call.

domains.description: Up to 6 brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["esteelauder.com","charlottetilbury.com"]. Omit for your own store plus your first tracked rivals.

sections.description: Optional: return only these parts (everything is returned when omitted). The full answer for several brands is large (about 25k tokens per 2 brands): ask for the sections you need, or fewer brands per call.
